doctor.name: Sevara Mirjalilovna Khamidova
doctor.title: Neurologist
doctor.tagline: Adult and pediatric neurology: a calm review of symptoms and a clear plan.
doctor.bio: I am a neurologist for children and adults. Visits are by appointment only, 30 minutes, 09:00–13:00. Mon, Wed and Fri — Medion Family Hospital (Istirohat St., 258). Tue and Sat — CityMed Clinic (Farabi St., 415). You can book on the website or through the Telegram bot.

booking.title: Choose a day and time
booking.lead: The calendar only opens working days. The slot you pick is at the clinic where Sevara Khamidova sees patients that day. Hours are 09:00–13:00, 30 minutes, by appointment.
booking.noSlots: No free slots on this day.
booking.name: Name
booking.phoneHint: The +998 code is already there — enter your number only.
booking.telegramHint: Optional. If you leave this empty, we will not send a reminder.

booking.cancelled: The appointment is cancelled. This time is free again.
